headline: Unbeaten Anderson and Catawba win again on the road
dek: Anderson have won four and drawn one, with twelve goals shared among seven different scorers and four conceded. Catawba, the conference's other unbeaten side, won away on the same night, and the two do not meet until October.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Mars Hill's thirteen goals are spread across eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Logan Knight's four.

wire.line: Only Anderson and Catawba remain unbeaten; Emory & Henry still have no published result at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every match Emory & Henry have had so far, the latest away at Chowan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry have lost all four of the matches that carry a result, scoring twice and conceding eleven. Giuseppe Gereau and Shotaro Sekinada are the only players to have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lincoln Memorial's Daniel Benedek Miklosi has made twenty saves and conceded five, without yet keeping a clean sheet.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate have scored four and conceded three, and have gone from two wins without conceding to two defeats in a row.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's Asher Risell has kept two clean sheets and conceded three goals.

last_match.line: Anderson have still not lost; Mount Olive had already been beaten by Mars Hill.

next_match.line: Catawba are unbeaten; Mars Hill have scored more than any other programme, and drew their last match at Florida Tech.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
